module two_flop_synchronizer ( 
  input clk_src, rst_src,
  input data_src,
  input clk_dst, rst_dst,
  output reg data_dst
);

  reg data_sync_1;

  always @(posedge clk_src or posedge rst_src) begin
    if (rst_src)
      data_sync_1 <= 1'b0;  // Reset synchronizer flops
    else
      data_sync_1 <= data_src; 
  end

  always @(posedge clk_dst or posedge rst_dst) begin
    if (rst_dst)
      data_dst <= 1'b0;   // Reset output flop
    else begin
      data_dst <= data_sync_1; 
    end
  end

endmodule
